newsitem.title: USA: Park National closes First-Knox merger.
newsitem.headline: Park National closes First-Knox merger.

text.p: Park National Corp said on Tuesday it had closed its merger with First-Knox Banc Corp and that First-Knox's subsidiaries, First-Knox National Bank and Farmers and Savings Bank, will now operate as separate affiliate banks of Park.

"With $2.2 billion in post-merger assets, Park will be able to realize the economies of a larger financial institution and further develop new products and delivery systems that appeal to today's customers," said Park chairman William McConnell.
In October, when the deal was announced, the companies said First-Knox shareholders would receive 0.5914 shares of Park for each share of First-Knox.
Park National Corp now has 53 banking offices and 1,099 employees serving customers in 15 central and southern Ohio counties, the company said.
